AIONix works with Artemis only, and every single Artemis is supplied with the system cartridge. 
The only scenario of the standalone system offering makes sense to me when there is a minor update (other than networking edition or AIONix 2) e.g. 1.1 version provides with small extensions. In such case old version cartridge can be replaced with new one for a small fee.
Such update cartridge replacements can be also bundled with the existing support service. 
The other scenario when system is provided to clone makers will be part or OEM contract rather than an official offering.

Let's turn this product to one-off system update (when old cartridge is replaced with the latest one) via Computerland/Academy facilities. 
Neither underlying software edition record nor this products mentions cartridge BOM in the composition section. 
Product shouldn't have technology references and feature specification, but rather leave such information to software edition records.
